script.title: Blood Relations: decoding relation phrases
script.caption_hook: Mother's brother's son: is he your brother? Decode it one link at a time.

lines.say: Mother's brother's son... is he my brother or what?
Break the phrase into links and decode one link at a time.

board.title: Blood Relations
board.sub: Decode one link at a time

lines.say: But what exactly is a blood relation?
It's by birth: parent, child, sibling, grandparent, uncle, aunt, cousin. In-laws come by marriage.
Okay, so how do I read a long phrase?
Learn five. Father's father is grandfather, plus two. Mother's brother is mama, plus one. Father's sister is bua, plus one.
So mama's son is my brother, right?
No, he's a cousin. A brother is a son of the same parents. Children of any uncle or aunt are cousins.
Oh! And what if the gender isn't given?
Never assume it. Fix the speaker's gender first, then each link's gender.
Can you show the mama's son example once?
Start with me. Mother is plus one. Her brother, my mama, is plus one. His son is level zero: cousin.
Got it! Mark the level, take one link.
Remember Level, Link, Look. Mark generation, take one link, then look back at the question.

check_notes: Checker: Line 6 (voice + board): Voice says 'Learn five' but names only three relations and the board shows four; 'Brother's daughter: -1' is on the board but never spoken. Fix: list all five in both voice and board (e.g. add 'Father's brother's son: 0'), or say the actual count and make the voice and board lists match.

Checker: Line 10 (voice): 'Never assume it. Fix the speaker's gender first' contradicts itself, because you can't fix a gender the question doesn't give. Correct: 'Never assume it. Note the speaker's and each link's gender only if the question states or implies it. If the answer depends on an unknown gender, it can't be determined.'

Checker: Line 12 (voice): 'Mother is plus one. Her brother, my mama, is plus one' can be heard as the levels adding up to +2. Clearer: 'Mother is plus one; her brother, my mama, is on the same level, plus one; his son is one level down, level zero: my cousin.'

Checker: Line 4 (voice + board): Listing 'uncle, aunt' as relations by birth is too broad, because an uncle's wife or an aunt's husband is related by marriage. Correct: 'Blood relation means related by birth: parent, child, sibling, grandparent, a parent's sibling and their children; spouses and in-laws come by marriage.'
